strings.account_help: Register or log in to store private lessons, design notes and progress. Password: 12-72 bytes. Username: 3-64 letters, digits or underscores.
strings.assistant_unavailable: Online assistant unavailable: an authorized anonymous gateway is not configured. No notes are sent to Free Chat. Downloaded copies do not use hosted models.
strings.private_chat_help: Save your goals, practice ideas and design notes here. Conversations stay private even when a lesson is published.
strings.title: Title
strings.assistant_ready: Choose an approved local or hosted model. Only the selected conversation's recent messages and your question are sent after you confirm. Review suggestions before saving a lesson.
strings.assistant_consent: Send this question and recent messages from this private conversation to the VPS and the selected model provider. Do not include passwords or sensitive personal data.
strings.use_assistant_text: Copy suggested practice text into a new lesson draft
strings.morse_text_help: Morse lessons use A-Z, digits and spaces. Text is normalized to uppercase.
strings.publish_help: New lessons are private. Publish only the lesson text to let other registered users practice it; chats and progress remain private.
strings.download_help: The ZIP includes runnable source and your private profile, but no account passwords, host credentials or other users' private data. Keep it private. Git ignores the profile; only explicitly published lesson text is included for Git sharing.
strings.lessons_generated: Lessons generated. Existing progress has been preserved.
strings.translate_loading: Loading optional Google Translate. Bundled translations work offline.
strings.translate_unavailable: Google Translate is unavailable or blocked. Use the bundled language selector, or open Google Translate to paste text. An internet connection is required.
